name: kodo
description: KODO - E-commerce platform with delivery and payments

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:vercel: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.test:integration:flows: cd server && npm run test:integration -- critical-flows.integration.test.js
scripts.test:integration:roles: cd server && npm run test:integration -- roles.integration.test.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:client: cd client && npm run lint || true
scripts.lint:server: cd server && npm run lint || true
